name: RaportProblems
title: Problem list with parsed diagnosis codes and encounter links
description: Requires api:fhir and system/Patient.$raport-problems. Takes no parameters. Returns every active problem list row of the patient (lists type medical_problem, activity 1), resolved ones included, sorted by lower-case UUID. Each diagnosis item (lists.diagnosis split on ';', blank items and exact repeats dropped, source order kept) is parsed with the host CodeTypesService: parseCode for type and code, getSystemForCodeType for the FHIR system and lookup_code_description for the description, which is empty unless the host has that code table installed. Encounter links are the issue_encounter rows of the problem. A row without a usable UUID, a blank title, a diagnosis item without a type or code, and a link to a missing, duplicate-numbered or other-patient encounter fail with 409. complete=true means no row was omitted: any access denial fails the request with 403.

part.name: begdate
part.documentation: As stored, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Absent when null or a zero date.

part.name: enddate
part.documentation: As stored, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Absent when null or a zero date; present on a resolved problem.

part.name: type
part.documentation: OpenEMR code type, such as ICD10 or SNOMED-CT.

part.name: system
part.documentation: The host's FHIR system for the code type. Absent for a type the host does not map.

part.name: description
part.documentation: From the host's installed code table. Absent when the code is not found there.

part.name: encounter
part.documentation: Linked encounter UUID, in UUID order.
